main_text.head: Eminentissimo Cardinali Barberino.
main_text.p: REdit in urbem D. Abraham Ecchel-lensis, officio, propter quod huc vocatus fuerat, diligenter & magno cum omnium doctorum applausu defunctus. Abiens vehemens sui desiderium illis re-liquit ; sperant hic cum bona Eminentiæ vestræ venia brevi reversurum, qua de re pluribus aget cum Eminentia vestra ipse Abraham, quem illi maximo cum affectu commendarem, nisi scirem commendatissimum, utpote ab ea & beneevolentia sua & beneficiis cumulatum: admonuit, credo, Eminentiam vestram Illustrissimus Nuntius de libro quodam paucis ante diebus à Jesuita composito, eumque ad eam aut misit aut mittit, necesse prorsus est, ut librum legat Eminentia vestra aut doctoribus legendum committat, & ab iis excerpta videat & diligenter consideret ; ea enim doctrinæ capita continet, quæ si affirmavero contineri, aut quivis alius, nemo nobis est crediturus, cùm in fronte gestet honori-ficum

page.notes: The large initial R is joined to "edit" as "REdit". Some letters are faint or speckled from the scan, but every word was readable. The punctuation after "credo" and "composito" is slightly unclear; I read them as commas.
